name: Genuine Service - HDFC Bank Automated Risk Alert (English)

caller_script.text: This is an automated security advisory from HDFC Bank Risk Prevention Desk regarding your debit card ending in 4102.
A transaction of 4,200 rupees at an online retail merchant was flagged at 1:45 AM. If this was made by you, no action is required.
Please remember, HDFC Bank will never ask for your password, PIN, or CVV. If this was not you, block your card in the official app or visit your home branch.
